ios.desc:
Dear Programmers! This is a special designer's stickers set for you!

Illustrated by artist Hanna Peraroslaya (@verypinkshark) who recently learned C# and feels that thing from inside. 
She gathered best programmer's memes and drew them in a cute way. 

Now you can surprise your friends and emphasise belonging to the caste of those, who can understand programmer's memes!


There are stickers about:
- Daily life of an programmer
- Quality of code and where do we get it from : D
- Some operands and reserved words, that could be wittily used in a discussion
- Special stickers for C++, PHP, C#, CSS, Java, Phyton, JS, C.

---------------------------------------------------------------
TO USE YOUR STICKERS AFTER INSTALLING:
Programmer Meme Stickers will automatically appear inside the iMessage application (green icon with a white bubble, standard iOS messaging app). 
Tap a small oval picture with a purple cat and you will get a list of your new stickers.

TIPS AND TRICKS:
To add a sticker: tap the sticker you want, or DRAG & DROP it into your message, even stick it over another messaging.
You can SCALE & ROTATE stickers by using a second finger before you place it on a bubble.
---------------------------------------------------------------

Hope, you will love this stickers set!
Feel free to suggest, which stickers and programming languages do you want to be added to this set!
